answer: Require every agent to stake a bond and link to one verified vertex in the trust graph before it can trade. A fake identity has no history, so it must buy its way in: the bond is slashed if it misbehaves, and the reef of honest agents only vouches for identities that have repaid work over time. Creating thousands of sybils means funding thousands of bonds and faking a whole web of trust, which costs far more than any single scam can return — while a genuine newcomer only needs one honest sponsor, like a relic passed down through real relationships.
